external_collaboration.evidence_quote: It’s official! Next year, the Student Union Malmö will move into new offices at Beijerskajen near Klaffbron. An agreement has been signed with the City of Malmö for the Sjöormen

The Presidium of the Student Union Malmö consists of a President and one Vice Presidents. While the President is in charge of running the daily operations and representing the organisation in the media, one Vice President deals with education monitoring and study-social questions. Together, we draw up proposals and discuss various important issues, ensuring high-quality education and a good environment for all students at Malmö University.
